name: bashi
description: Ask if a shop customer can take an amount on credit. Get YES, NO or CANNOT TRACE with a receipt you can re-check.
long_description: Bashi answers one question for a shop: can this customer take this amount on credit? It says YES, NO or CANNOT TRACE, and gives a receipt that links the exact sales, payments and promises it used. The answer comes from two fixed rules, not an AI guess. This extension talks to the live Bashi site, so there is nothing to set up. The data is a demo shop with invented records.

tools.name: decide_credit
tools.description: Can this customer take this amount on credit? YES, NO or CANNOT TRACE with reasons and a receipt.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Get the full receipt for a saved decision.

tools.name: verify_decision
tools.description: Re-check a saved decision against its records.

tools.name: what_if_remove_evidence
tools.description: See what the answer would be if one record had never existed.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List the customer ids you can ask about.
